title: Synthesis and computational insights of flavone derivatives as potential estrogen receptor alpha (ER-alpha) antagonist.
authors: Fegade, Bharti S; Jadhav, Shailaja B; Chaudhari, Somdatta Y; T Tandale, Deepak; Shantaram Uttekar, Pravin; Tabrez, Shams; Khan, Mohd Shahnawaz; Zaidi, Syed Kashif; Mukerjee, Nobendu; Ghosh, Arabinda
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮衍生物作为ER-alpha拮抗剂，通过分子对接和MD模拟分析蛋白-配体结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽可迁移但非TF-DNA体系，故评分较低。
abstract: Hormone-related breast cancer is mostly caused by interactions with estrogen receptor alpha (ER-alpha), which functions as a transcription factor to control the transcription of numerous genes. Flavones are considered a good substrate for the estrogen receptor. Substitution of the N-heterocyclic ring on the flavon structure may potentiate its anticancer effect. A series of flavon derivatives with an N-heteroaryl ring at the 4' position of the B ring of flavon were designed, prepared and evaluated for in vitro breast cancer activity. Binding interactions of the PzFL, PzF, PiFL, PiF and IFL compounds with ER-alpha were studied by molecular docking. Molecular dynamics simulation studies were carried out in order to determine the stability and convergence of protein-ligand complexes. The compounds were produced by cyclizing chalcones and chalcones were produced by Claisen-Schmidt condensation of substituted aldehydes and 2-hydroxy acetophenone. Breast cancer activity was evaluated by the MTT assay on MCF-7 cell lines. Also, compounds were studied for their estrogen receptor binding potential on the same cell lines. Molecular docking of compounds showed a good docking score. The molecular dynamics of these compounds expressed stable root mean square deviation, stable radius of gyration and low binding energy, suggesting that ligand bound to protein is quite stable in the complex. MTT assay on MCF-7 cell lines reported PzF and IFL were the most active compounds with lower IC(50) values. ER-alpha binding assay of these compounds revealed the presence of binding interactions with receptors. This study offers a viable reference point for the design of flavon-incorporated N-heterocyclic ring derivatives as breast cancer compounds.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 激素相关性乳腺癌主要由雌激素受体α（ER-alpha）的相互作用引起，该受体作为转录因子控制众多基因的转录。黄酮类化合物被认为是雌激素受体的良好底物。在黄酮结构上取代N-杂环可能增强其抗癌效果。设计、制备了一系列在黄酮B环4'位带有N-杂芳基环的黄酮衍生物，并评估了其体外乳腺癌活性。通过分子对接研究了PzFL、PzF、PiFL、PiF和IFL化合物与ER-alpha的结合相互作用。进行了分子动力学模拟研究，以确定蛋白质-配体复合物的稳定性和收敛性。这些化合物通过环化查尔酮制备，而查尔酮则通过取代醛和2-羟基苯乙酮的Claisen-Schmidt缩合反应合成。乳腺癌活性通过MTT法在MCF-7细胞系上评估。同时，还在相同细胞系上研究了这些化合物的雌激素受体结合潜力。化合物的分子对接显示出良好的对接分数。这些化合物的分子动力学表现出稳定的均方根偏差、稳定的回旋半径和低结合能，表明配体与蛋白质结合在复合物中相当稳定。MCF-7细胞系上的MTT法报告显示，PzF和IFL是最具活性的化合物，具有较低的IC(50)值。这些化合物的ER-alpha结合测定揭示了与受体的结合相互作用的存在。本研究为设计含黄酮的N-杂环衍生物作为乳腺癌化合物提供了可行的参考点。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
